newsitem.title: USA: US Industries outlook unchanged by unit sale.
newsitem.headline: US Industries outlook unchanged by unit sale.

text.p: U.S. Industries Inc said Monday it still sees full year earnings per share from continuing operations of $2.15-$2.20, despite the sale of its Odyssey Sports unit.
Earlier today the company said it has agreed to sell to Callaway Golf Co all of the assets of Odyssey Sports Inc for $130 million icash.
U.S. Industries said that as a result of the sale it expects to net proceeds of about $80 million, and generate an after-tax gain of about $50 million.

"Irrespective of the elimination of expected earnings from our golf division, we still anticipate achieving full year earnings per share from continuing operations in the range of $2.15 to $2.20," David Clarke, U.S. Industries chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"We will now focus on maximizing value at Armour Golf, which is a premium golf club manufacturer with an excellent position in titanium irons," Clarke added.
